data.content:
1	/-
2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import Mathlib
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.SymPowColimit
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.AlbaneseFromData
9	
10	/-!
11	# Milne III.6.1 with the symmetric power *constructed*, not assumed
12	
13	`Albanese/AlbaneseFromData.lean` proves the Albanese universal property over the interface
14	`SymPowData` — but takes the interface **as a hypothesis**, together with its symmetry
15	`hproj`. `Albanese/SymPowColimit.lean` then identifies that pair with a colimit of the
16	permutation action. This file composes the two, so the capstone no longer takes a
17	symmetric-power argument at all.
18	
19	## What changes
20	
21	`exists_unique_albanese_of_scheme_colimits` states Milne III.6.1 with
22	
23	* **no `SymPowData` argument** — the symmetric power is `symPowOfColimit C g`;
24	* **no `hproj` argument** — the symmetry is discharged internally by
25	  `symPowOfColimit_proj_perm`, i.e. by `colimit.w`;
26	* one typeclass hypothesis in their place:
27	  `HasColimitsOfShape (SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin g))) Scheme`.
28	
29	That hypothesis is the honest residue of the whole leg, and by
30	`hasColimit_permDiagram_iff` it is *equivalent* to what the previous statement assumed —
31	so nothing was strengthened in the trade. What it is not is a curve statement, a base
32	statement, or a 2400-line construction scope: it is quotients of schemes by finite group
33	actions, absolute.
34	
35	## What is still assumed, and why it is not this leg's debt
36	
37	Milne III.5.1(a) birationality of `f^{(g)}`, in the same explicit form
38	`AlbaneseFromData.lean` already used: a section over a dense open, a retraction, dominance,
39	two density facts, and the structure-map compatibility `hover`. Those are hypotheses here
40	too. They are geometry about the *Jacobian*, downstream of the Picard seam, and the
41	`ajc-pic0av` lane owns their inputs.
42	
43	## References
44	
45	Milne, *Abelian Varieties*, §III.6 Proposition 6.1, p. 104; §III.5 Theorem 5.1(a), p. 101.
46	Blueprint `thm:albanese_universal_property`.
47	-/
48	
49	set_option autoImplicit false
50	
51	universe u
52	
53	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory MonObj
54	
55	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
56	
57	variable {kbar : Type u} [Field kbar] [IsAlgClosed kbar]
58	
59	/-- **Milne Proposition III.6.1, with the symmetric power constructed.**
60	
61	Identical to `exists_unique_albanese_factorisation_of_birational` except that the
62	symmetric-power interface and its symmetry hypothesis are gone: the symmetric power is
63	`symPowOfColimit C g`, a colimit of the `S_g`-action on `C^g`, and its projection's
64	symmetry is `colimit.w`.
65	
66	The remaining hypotheses are exactly Milne III.5.1(a)'s birationality data, unchanged from
67	the sibling statement. The one typeclass hypothesis
68	`HasColimitsOfShape (SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin g))) Scheme` is this leg's single open
69	obligation, and it is equivalent — not merely sufficient — to the datum previously
70	assumed (`hasColimit_permDiagram_iff`).
71	
72	Axiom-clean. -/
73	theorem exists_unique_albanese_of_scheme_colimits
74	    {C : Over (Spec (.of kbar))} {g : ℕ}
75	    [HasColimitsOfShape (SingleObj (Equiv.Perm (Fin g))) Scheme.{u}]
76	    (P0 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of kbar))) ⟶ C) (i₀ : Fin g)
77	    {J A : Over (Spec (.of kbar))}
78	    [GrpObj J] [IsProper J.hom] [Smooth J.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible J.hom]
79	    [IsIntegral J.left] [IsReduced J.left]
80	    [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom] [Smooth A.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom]
81	    [IsReduced ((symPowOfColimit C g).carrier).left]
82	    (φ : C ⟶ A) (hφ : P0 ≫ φ = η[A])
83	    (aj : C ⟶ J) (f : (symPowOfColimit C g).carrier ⟶ J)
84	    (hf : letI : IsCommMonObj J := isCommMonObj_of_isProper_smooth_of_package J
85	      (symPowOfColimit C g).proj ≫ f = powSum g aj)
86	    (haj0 : P0 ≫ aj = η[J])
87	    (hfd : IsDominant f.left)
88	    (V : J.left.Opens) (hV : Dense (V : Set J.left))
89	    (hVpre : Dense ((f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V : ((symPowOfColimit C g).carrier).left.Opens) :
90	      Set ((symPowOfColimit C g).carrier).left))
91	    (s : (V : Scheme) ⟶ ((symPowOfColimit C g).carrier).left) (hs : s ≫ f.left = V.ι)
92	    (hsr : f.left.resLE V (f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ s = (f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)
93	    (hover : letI : IsCommMonObj A := isCommMonObj_of_isProper_smooth_of_package A
94	      (Scheme.PartialMap.mk V hV
95	          (s ≫ ((symPowOfColimit C g).symAVMap φ).left)).toRationalMap.compHom A.hom
96	        = J.hom.toRationalMap) :
97	    ∃! ψ : J ⟶ A, φ = aj ≫ ψ :=
98	  exists_unique_albanese_factorisation_of_birational (symPowOfColimit C g)
99	    (symPowOfColimit_proj_perm C g) P0 i₀ φ hφ aj f hf haj0 hfd V hV hVpre s hs hsr hover
100	
101	end AlgebraicGeometry
102
